report.summary: Payments were slow due to a latency spike in payments-api caused by its synchronous dependency, ledger-service. The ledger-service latency spike was triggered by the full rollout of the ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag from 10% to 100% at 13:18 UTC, immediately preceding the onset of the latency anomaly at 13:19 UTC in ledger-service and 13:20 UTC in payments-api.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Ledger reconciliation feature flag rollout causes latency spike

supporting.note: Feature flag change at 13:18 UTC immediately precedes the ledger-service latency spike at 13:19 UTC.
Shows ledger-service p99 latency spiking sharply upward starting at 13:19.
Shows payments-api p99 latency spiking starting at 13:20.
Confirms synchronous dependency from payments-api to ledger-service.

contradicting.note: Ledger-service CPU percentage showed no notable anomaly during the incident window.
Ledger-service error rate remained stable without an anomaly during the window.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Ledger database degradation causes cascading latency

supporting.note: Ledger-service logged warnings about retrying calls to ledger-db starting at 12:23 UTC.
Confirms ledger-service latency spike starting at 13:19 UTC.
Confirms payments-api latency spike starting at 13:20 UTC.

contradicting.note: Feature flag change at 13:18 UTC provides a much tighter temporal correlation to the sharp onset at 13:19 than database warnings occurring hours prior.

facts.text: payments-api p99 latency increased from baseline ~382.67ms to 3239.85ms at 2026-10-11T13:20:00+00:00, peaking at 3521.46ms at 13:27.
ledger-service p99 latency increased from baseline ~120.79ms to 3196.98ms starting at 2026-10-11T13:19:00+00:00, peaking at 3364.94ms at 13:23:00+00:00.
TLS deprecation warnings in payments-api logs occurred continuously from 12:00:00+00:00 onwards, preceding the latency spike by over an hour.
ledger-service had a feature flag rollout chg-9802 (ledger.reconciliation_v2 from 10% to 100%) at 2026-10-11T13:18:00+00:00, which precedes the reported latency symptom onset at ~13:20 UTC.

assumptions: The new reconciliation logic under ledger.reconciliation_v2 causes thread waiting or I/O waits rather than high CPU usage.

timeline.event: Feature flag ledger.reconciliation_v2 rolled out from 10% to 100% on ledger-service.
ledger-service p99 latency begins to spike.
payments-api p99 latency begins to spike.

recommended_actions.action: Roll back the ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag on ledger-service to 10% or disable it completely.
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly mitigates the root cause introduced by chg-9802.

recommended_actions.action: Investigate the ledger.reconciliation_v2 codebase for blocking calls or inefficient execution patterns that cause high latency without increasing CPU usage.
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevents future regressions when attempting to roll out the feature flag again.

recommended_actions.action: Implement strict performance and timeout safeguards for synchronous inter-service calls.
recommended_actions.rationale: Limits blast radius when upstream dependencies like ledger-service experience unexpected processing delays.
